Speed dial and voicemail

Güven Phone Help Guide, version 2.0.22

Open Speed dial in Settings, choose a key from 2 to 9 and assign a contact. If the contact has several numbers, you choose which one is called.

Choose an assigned key to change or remove the assignment.

To call, open the Keypad tab with the number field empty and long-press the assigned key. With a screen reader, find the key, double-tap and keep your finger down on the second tap.

With Slide to Enter Numbers on, slide your finger to the key and hold it there for about two seconds without lifting.

If you long-press a key with no contact, you are asked whether to set it up.

Long-pressing 1 calls voicemail. On the Speed dial screen, choose key 1 to enter the Voicemail number for each SIM; if you leave it empty, your operator’s number is used.
